Every browser-only sibling/barrel (StatCard/InlineMetric L4, EmptyState L5, WidgetShell L13, ./types L14) is reproduced self-contained inline per the established inline-reproduction precedent.

L36-37 `const {unitPrefs} = useUnits(); const toDistanceDisplay = (value) => convertDistanceFromSI(value, unitPrefs.distance)` -> the converter is wrapped in React.useCallback keyed on [unitPrefs.distance] (web defines it inline/recreated-each-render). This is the react-hooks/exhaustive-deps-suggested fix and yields IDENTICAL output: the L44 metrics memo is a pure function of (data, unitPrefs.distance), so memoizing the converter only removes the web source's redundant per-render recompute — the produced metrics value is unchanged. unitPrefs.distance is read exactly as the web source.

'Wh/mi' : 'Wh/km'; toEfficiencyDisplay = (whPerKm) => unitPrefs.distance === 'mi' ? whPerKm * 1.609344 : whPerKm (wrapped in React.useCallback keyed on [unitPrefs.distance] for the same identical-output reason as toDistanceDisplay); `const {formatCurrency} = useFormatting()`.

The deps array [data, toDistanceDisplay, toEfficiencyDisplay] is preserved verbatim; drives/prevDrives are computed-but-unrendered exactly like the web source. The pre-existing km->mi / Wh-per-km->Wh-per-mi pre-scaling that feeds convertDistanceFromSI/toEfficiencyDisplay is preserved unchanged (behaviour parity; not 'fixed'). The two converters are wrapped in useCallback (see L36-37 note), so the memo's deps are stable and exhaustive-deps is satisfied without any eslint-disable; the memoized metrics value is identical to the web source's per-render recompute.
